items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The helper names say what they do (`_filter_prefetch_queryset`, `_filter_prefetch_queryset_by_predicate`), the docstring explains the ROW_NUMBER() emulation, and the formatting matches the existing imports and code.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: One short shared helper serves the reverse FK, M2M and generic relation paths. It reuses ORM pieces (Window, RowNumber, lookups, clear_limits, get_order_by). The temporary zz_tmp test was deleted, and there is no dead code or duplicated logic.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Raises a specific `NotSupportedError` when `not connections[db].features.supports_over_clause`. Handles `high_mark is None`. No swallowed errors and no magic constants.

items.name: Per-parent slice semantics for open/bounded slices
items.name_zh: 开放/有界切片按父对象分区
items.evidence: `Window(RowNumber(), partition_by=partition_by, ...)` filters with `GreaterThan(window, low_mark)`, and with `LessThanOrEqual` only when `high_mark is not None`. `clear_limits()` runs on the clone made by `.using()` in each prefetch path, so the user's queryset is not changed.
